snippet.title: Major Mayhem 2
snippet.description:
Major Mayhem is back, and he's bringing even MORE firepower! 💥

Get ready for explosive arcade action in Major Mayhem 2! Run, jump, dodge and blast your way through action-packed missions packed with bad guys, big guns and even bigger explosions.

More mayhem. More destruction. More ridiculous fun!
